attorneys.name: Kenneth H. Carlson
attorneys.title: Founder & Principal Attorney
attorneys.bio_excerpt: Ken Carlson has been an attorney helping tenants since 1980, over 45 years ago. He created the caltenantlaw.com website in 1999.

attorneys.name: Kavin Williams
attorneys.title: Associate Attorney
attorneys.bio_excerpt: Kavin Williams is the founder and owner of KAW LAW, a law practice established in September 2022 that specializes in tenant advocacy and consumer rights law. Prior to founding KAW LAW, Kavin served as a staff attorney for the Eviction Defense Collaborative, one of San Francisco’s leading tenant rights organizations.

attorneys.name: Jeremy Cook
attorneys.title: Associate Attorney
attorneys.office: California Tenant Law — Downtown Los Angeles
attorneys.bio_excerpt: Jeremy Cook serves as our Downtown Los Angeles tenant rights attorney, providing dedicated legal representation to renters throughout the Los Angeles basin. Located in the heart of Downtown LA, our office offers convenient access for tenants dealing with the unique challenges of LA’s competitive rental market.

attorneys.name: Brian Barajas
attorneys.title: Associate Attorney
attorneys.bio_excerpt: Brian Barajas is licensed to practice in both California and Washington D.C. He has been practicing eviction law for over two years and holds a Master of Social Work (MSW) from the University of Southern California—a background that brings valuable insight into the personal and social challenges tenants face during housing disputes.

attorneys.name: Brittany Torbert
attorneys.title: Associate Attorney
attorneys.bio_excerpt: Brittany Torbert brings perseverance, determination, and raw grit to every case—qualities that enable her to overcome obstacles and achieve results for her clients. Brittany’s values and client-centered outlook ensure tenants have a positive environment and an attorney they can trust.

attorneys.name: Chelsea Cooper
attorneys.title: Associate Attorney
attorneys.bio_excerpt: Chelsea Cooper is a dedicated attorney with deep expertise in landlord-tenant law, having successfully resolved issues for over 200 tenants—whether in the courtroom or through strategic negotiation. Chelsea finds the complexities of landlord-tenant law intriguing, as each case offers unique challenges that often intersect with other legal domains.

attorneys.name: Perrin F. Disner
attorneys.title: Associate Attorney
attorneys.office: California Tenant Law — San Fernando Valley
attorneys.bio_excerpt: Perrin F. Disner brings over 17 years of litigation experience to CalTenantLaw’s San Fernando Valley practice. Disner earned his Bachelor of Arts degree and Juris Doctorate from the University of Michigan, and has been a member in good standing of the State Bar of California since 2008.

attorneys.name: Samara Weiner
attorneys.title: Associate Attorney
attorneys.office: California Tenant Law — San Luis Obispo County
attorneys.bio_excerpt: Samara Weiner brings extensive litigation experience to CalTenantLaw and the Central Coast community. Ms. Weiner honed her skills as former In-House Counsel for major California brands including POM Wonderful, Wonderful Pistachios and Almonds, FIJI Water, JUSTIN Vineyards & Winery, Landmark Winery, and Paramount Citrus.
